tasks.label: build
tasks.detail: Full build: transformer → types → eastwind (root: pnpm build)

tasks.label: build eastwind
tasks.detail: Builds the eastwind app layers (data + server + client) and their altea deps. preLaunchTask for the API server debug configs.

tasks.label: build eastwind terminal
tasks.detail: Builds the eastwind terminal layer (CLI host + loaders; references data + server). preLaunchTask for the terminal debug configs.

tasks.label: watch types
tasks.detail: tspc -b --watch — keeps emitted JS fresh for vite dev.

tasks.label: dev (eastwind)
tasks.detail: Runs eastwind types + server + client watchers (root: pnpm dev).

tasks.label: build eastwind server bundle
tasks.detail: Bundles transformer-emitted logic JS into one runnable file (used by the server debugger).

tasks.label: build quote-transformer
tasks.detail: Compiles the ts-patch transformer itself (altea/quote-transformer -> dist).

tasks.label: build quote-transformer-test
tasks.detail: Compiles the transformer's test package (and the transformer it loads); preLaunchTask for the transformer-test debug configs.

tasks.label: build @altea/altea test (tspc -b)
tasks.detail: Compiles @altea/altea (framework + its internalized test/ suite) to dist; preLaunchTask for the framework test debug configs. Skip the wait by running 'watch types' instead.

tasks.label: eastwind full stack — PostgreSQL
tasks.detail: Build types, then run the API server (Postgres) + vite client + tspc watch together (pnpm stack:postgres). Open http://localhost:5173.

tasks.label: eastwind full stack — SQL Server
tasks.detail: Build types, then run the API server (SQL Server) + vite client + tspc watch together (pnpm stack:sqlserver). Open http://localhost:5173.
